text:
sarah: Heads-up — saw a big spike in preemptible GPU evictions in us-west1 between 05:10-05:30. Affected nodepool: gpu-spot-usw1-t4. Pod churn caused autoscaler thrash and a few inference jobs got OOM or long tail latency.

matt: ugh. saw the alert. any pattern on AZ or instance type?

sarah: mostly a single AZ (us-west1-b) and T4s. eviction logs show typical preemptible notices ~30s before termination. Cluster-autoscaler kept trying to spin up new spot nodes but rate-limited by quota and then on-demand backfills kicked in late.

leo: can we reduce churn by pinning low-priority workloads to a separate tainted pool and only allow best-effort pods there? we already have taint: "spot=true:NoSchedule" on gpu-spot pools but some controllers ignore tolerations.

anya: +1. also we should ensure our PDBs for long-running inference workers are set so CA doesn't evict them mid-job. right now a few pods had disruption_count > 1.

matt: proposed short checklist: 1) cordon flawed nodes earlier when preempt notice arrives 2) ensure node draining uses --delete-local-data and respects PDBs 3) spin a tiny on-demand hot-standby pool per region (1-2 A100 or T4 reserved) 4) tweak autoscaler expander to "least-waste" and set scaleDownUnneededTime higher during peak churn windows.

sarah: agree. to cordon on notice we can plug the metadata-notify hook into our termination handler. infra-bot: can you post the last 10 eviction events for gpu-spot-usw1-t4? :eyes:

infra-bot: [automated] eviction-events for gpu-spot-usw1-t4 (last 10):
- 2024-07-12T05:11:12Z PREEMPTION_NOTICE node/gpu-spot-27 
- 2024-07-12T05:12:01Z PREEMPTION_NOTICE node/gpu-spot-31 
- 2024-07-12T05:14:45Z PREEMPTION_NOTICE node/gpu-22 
- 2024-07-12T05:15:09Z PREEMPTION_NOTICE node/gpu-08 
- 2024-07-12T05:16:30Z PREEMPTION_NOTICE node/gpu-19 
(remaining truncated)

leo: that looks like a 10-15m eviction wave. for fallback: instead of huge on-demand pool, what about a micro warm pool that keeps nodes booted but cordoned and tainted so they don't accept pods until we uncordon? cheaper than running full on-demand under load but faster than cold starts.

anya: nit: GKE has node auto-provisioning warm pool alpha we tested — warm nodes still incur instance-hour cost. If we do our own warm pool, keep image and kernel versions in sync. Also ensure GPU drivers loaded early (start-up script).

matt: agree on driver preload. also let's add a short-lived runbook snippet for ops: 
```
# ops checklist for spot eviction wave
1. @oncall run: kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-spot-usw1 -o wide
2. cordon noisy nodes: kubectl cordon <node>
3. graceful drain if workloads tolerable: kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
4. scale up fallback pool: gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize gpu-fallback-usw1 --size=2
5. watch: kubectl get pods -n infra -w
```

sarah: nice. can we add autoscaler params we want to apply? i'd lower scaleDownUtilizationThreshold to 0.3 for spot pools and increase scaleDownUnneededTime to 20m during known churn windows.

leo: also set expander: "most-pods" isn't great; least-waste helps with mixed GPU sizes. and add maxNodeProvisionTime to 15m to avoid premature retries.

anya: cost note: adding a 2-node on-demand fallback in us-west1 increases monthly spend by approx $4.5k (A100) or ~$500 (T4), depending on family. recommend using T4 fallback for cost-sensitive workloads and reserve A100 only for high-SLA customers.

matt: good point. for now let's trial T4 warm pool of 2 nodes in us-west1 and a single standby T4 in asia-east1. Sarah — can you open a short PR to change CA config and add the warm pool IaC?

sarah: on it. i'll draft PR with the autoscaler flags, taint changes, and warm pool TF for review. planning to include a small smoke test that schedules inference job onto fallback nodes to validate GPU drivers.

leo: sweet. one more: add an alert for "spot eviction rate > 5/min for 10m" per region so we preemptively scale the fallback.

anya: and tag the fallback pool with billing code so finance can track the incremental cost. :money_with_wings:

matt: cool — let's coordinate timeline in the PR. thanks all. :thumbsup:
